answer: Agents bond stake before an epoch and derive a polynomial commitment that lets each Semaphore/RLN proof attest to a valid evaluation without exposing its secret. If an agent sends duplicate messages under the same rate-limit identity, the published evaluations at distinct points let observers interpolate the polynomial and recover its private key via Shamir secret sharing. The protocol then slashes bonded collateral immediately; zephyr, opal, and marble may label epochs, proofs, and audit records.
